summary: Comprehensive testing of QMRT simulation universe system completed successfully. All backend API endpoints verified working with proper physics engine integration. Frontend dashboard, world generation, and all UI components tested and functioning correctly.

design_issues.issue: Missing accessibility descriptions for dialog components
design_issues.details: Console warnings about missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent components

passed_tests: Backend: All 6 API endpoints (GET /api/, POST /api/worlds, GET /api/worlds, GET /api/worlds/{id}, DELETE /api/worlds/{id}, GET /api/substrate/info)
Backend: QMRT physics engine world generation with proper death-world scaling (1-15)
Backend: Input validation and error handling
Frontend: Dashboard loads correctly with Universe Catalog title
Frontend: Stats bar displays correct totals (total worlds, apex qualified count, average death level)
Frontend: Create world modal with form validation, name input, death level slider (1-15), and seed input
Frontend: World generation integration with backend API
Frontend: World cards display proper metrics (bio viability, survival difficulty, gravity, resources)
Frontend: Apex qualification badges shown for level 10+ worlds
Frontend: Death-world level classification displayed correctly (Earth-Class World)
Frontend: World detail modal with parameter tabs (World Parameters, Substrate Physics)
Frontend: Substrate info modal displays QMRT theory information
Physics: QMRT substrate physics engine generates realistic world parameters
Classification: Proper world classification based on death-world levels
